name: web-two-factor-authentication-setup-card-with-numbered-timeline-and-qr
title: White card 'Enable Two-Factor Authentication' with a shield icon, a vertical numbered timeline, a QR code and six code boxes
whatItIs: A white rounded card with a soft circle holding a shield icon, a centred bold title and grey subtitle, a hairline and three numbered steps linked by a thin vertical line: Download app, Scan QR code with a QR image, and Enter code with six empty rounded input boxes.
whatItMeans: Clear and reassuring; a numbered timeline makes a security setup feel manageable.
techniques: Show steps on a vertical timeline.
Place the QR inside the step it belongs to.

vocabulary.definition: Numbered steps joined by a vertical line.
Separate boxes for each digit of a code.
A soft circle behind an icon.
A card guiding a multi-step task.
